description: This file defines API route endpoints for a Notes service, implementing CRUD operations using FastAPI.

classes.name: NoteService
classes.description: Service class handling business logic for notes, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting notes.

methods.name: NoteService _service(db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Dependency injection that creates an instance of NoteService with database session.

methods.name: List[NoteOut] list_notes(svc: NoteService = Depends(_service))
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve a list of all notes, ordered by creation date.

methods.name: NoteOut create_note(payload: NoteCreate, svc: NoteService = Depends(_service))
methods.description: API endpoint to create a new note with a title and content.

methods.name: NoteOut get_note(note_id: int, svc: NoteService = Depends(_service))
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve a specific note by its ID.

methods.name: NoteOut update_note(note_id: int, payload: NoteUpdate, svc: NoteService = Depends(_service))
methods.description: API endpoint to update fields of an existing note.

methods.name: Response delete_note(note_id: int, svc: NoteService = Depends(_service))
methods.description: API endpoint to delete a note by its ID.

ctags.name: create_note
ctags.pattern: /^def create_note(payload: NoteCreate, svc: NoteService = Depends(_service)) -> NoteOut:$/

ctags.name: delete_note
ctags.pattern: /^def delete_note(note_id: int, svc: NoteService = Depends(_service)) -> Response:$/

ctags.name: get_note
ctags.pattern: /^def get_note(note_id: int, svc: NoteService = Depends(_service)) -> NoteOut:$/

ctags.name: update_note
ctags.pattern: /^def update_note(note_id: int, payload: NoteUpdate, svc: NoteService = Depends(_service)) -> Note/
ctags.signature: (note_id: int, payload: NoteUpdate, svc: NoteService = Depends(_service))
